issues: Both confirmed citations check out against the fetched primary sources. (1) Chughtai et al. 2302.03025 Table 6 (Transformer): S5 = sign + one faithful 4d irrep in 4/4 seeds. A5 = {3d-a,3d-b} exactly in 2/4 seeds and contains the pair in 3/4, but that third seed (seed 3) did not fully generalise (test loss 1.95e-01); seed 4 = {standard}. Table 5 / Fig. 7 (ReLU MLP): S5 uses 2-4 key representations; A5 always includes the 4d standard irrep. Chughtai never says 'Galois conjugate'; App. D.1.4 only says the 6d S5 irrep splits into two 3d A5 irreps. (2) Stander et al. (PMLR 235:46441-46467, fields verified): S5/S6 only, no A5. The Sec. 7 'single irrep' is per neuron, not per network, and it notes the (3,2)/(2,2,1) 5d irreps are used 'depending on the run'. So it is a caveat, not support. Problem with the checker's recommended rewrite: it cites 'our runs (Section~\ref{sec:experiments})', but the current experiments.tex has no group experiments (TODO subsections on interference, the s-exponent and the degree/norm dials only), so 'as observed' has no referent in the paper. Either add the S5/A5 runs to experiments or the appendix, or rest the sentence on Chughtai Table 6 alone. Bib: chughtai2023toy lacks series PMLR, volume 202 and pages 6243--6267 (verified on proceedings.mlr.press/v202/chughtai23a.html). stander2024grokking is missing from refs.bib. Process note: WebSearch returned 'session has used its web search budget (200 of 200)', so every later verifier that needs search (novelty lenses) is running without search.
